about: One window at a time (2026-11-22: one open window at a time for now, either a file or an agent, never both, the same rule as the top-right panels such as Plan use). Run on the made-up floor, live.html?stress=6&tick=1, any server; sends nothing and saves nothing (a typed character is taken back with Backspace). An agent's window open, a page clicked: the file window opens and the agent window closes, the agent let go (no highlight); an agent clicked with the file open: the file window closes. An unsaved edit in the file window when an agent opens: kept (the page's dot, a line at the foot saying so, the edit shown again when the file reopens). A file link in the agent's chat: the file opens, the chat closes. Escape closes whichever window is open. A top-right panel folded away by the chat does not come back over a file opened from that chat. The chat-link and Plan-use steps need a floor whose chats carry file links and whose ledger has rows; the made-up floor has neither, so they run on a real floor (no agent is started, nothing is sent).
